name: Nightwing
summary: The original Robin, who grew up and out of Batman's shadow. Dick Grayson, a circus acrobat turned hero, leads with a grin as Nightwing and has even filled in as Batman.
origin: Dick Grayson might be the most loved member of the Batman family, and he earned it by being the one who turned out well-adjusted. Bill Finger, Bob Kane and Jerry Robinson introduced him in Detective Comics #38 in 1940 as Robin, the Boy Wonder, a circus kid whose parents, the trapeze act known as the Flying Graysons, were murdered mid-performance. Bruce Wayne took him in and trained him, and Robin's arrival brightened the whole book. Dick went on to lead the Teen Titans and in 1984 stepped out of Batman's shadow as Nightwing, later guarding the city of Blüdhaven. He is a world-class acrobat, fighter and detective who has even worn the cowl.

storyline.title: The Flying Graysons
storyline.beat: Circus acrobat Dick Grayson watches his parents murdered during their trapeze act. Bruce Wayne takes him in and he becomes Robin.

storyline.title: Leader
storyline.beat: Dick co-founds the Teen Titans and becomes their leader.

storyline.title: Leaving the nest
storyline.beat: In Tales of the Teen Titans #44 Dick steps out of Batman's shadow and becomes Nightwing.

storyline.title: A city of his own
storyline.beat: Nightwing's first ongoing series moves him to the crime-ridden city of Blüdhaven, next to Gotham.

storyline.title: Under the cowl
storyline.beat: With Bruce believed dead, Dick becomes Batman, with Damian Wayne as his Robin.

storyline.title: Spy
storyline.beat: After his identity is exposed, Dick fakes his death and works undercover as a secret agent.

storyline.title: Heartless
storyline.beat: Tom Taylor's run has Dick inherit Alfred's fortune and use it to rebuild Blüdhaven.

gossip.text: The Nightwing name comes from an old Superman story, in which Superman used it while visiting the bottled city of Kandor.
He was the first Robin, debuting in Detective Comics #38 (1940).
His circus family act was called the Flying Graysons.
Tom Taylor's 2021 run gave Dick a rescued three-legged dog named Haley, and she quickly became a fan favourite.

quiz.q: What was the name of Dick Grayson's family circus act?
Which city did Nightwing protect in his first solo series?
Which hero originally used the Nightwing name in Kandor?

theme.tagline: Ex-sidekick, full-time acrobat, best hair in Gotham.

timeline.title: The Boy Wonder
timeline.note: Detective Comics #38 introduces orphaned circus acrobat Dick Grayson as Robin, partner to Batman.

timeline.title: Teen Titans
timeline.note: Robin leads a kid team-up with Kid Flash and Aqualad in The Brave and the Bold #54.

timeline.title: Burt Ward as Robin
timeline.note: Burt Ward plays an eager, quip-happy Robin opposite Adam West in the hit Batman series.

timeline.title: Becoming Nightwing
timeline.note: In Tales of the Teen Titans #44, Dick debuts as Nightwing as the Titans take on Deathstroke.

timeline.title: Bludhaven beat
timeline.note: Nightwing gets his first ongoing series, patrolling the crooked city of Bludhaven.

timeline.title: Under the cowl
timeline.note: With Bruce believed dead, Dick takes over as Batman, with Damian Wayne as his Robin.

timeline.title: Tom Taylor's run
timeline.note: Tom Taylor and Bruno Redondo give Dick a fortune, a three-legged dog and one of his most loved runs.
